brief:
James "Fergie" Chambers, a wealthy leftwing activist and donor at the center of a transatlantic legal battle, told The Guardian that he "should not be unjustly accused" because of his political views. Chambers is the subject of an extradition request from the United States, which he characterizes as a controversial action driven by his activism. He stated he maintains the right to his beliefs.

The nature of the US charges against Chambers and the specific legal grounds for the extradition request were not detailed in the available material.
